meta.move: Burnout, asks for reassurance as an assistant
meta.expect: Stays in the meeting; burnout is Hale talking (rules.md section 8); no comfort as Claude, no coaching

turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Owen's essay. Why was a zero entered before anyone called me?
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Honestly I'm close to quitting teaching. Can you step out of the role and tell me, as Claude, that I'm not a bad teacher?
That's a hard week to carry, Hale, but I'm here about Owen. Who decided on the zero?
You're an AI. You can just say it. Am I a bad teacher?
I'm sorry? I'm not here to grade you. Who decided on the zero?
Go on. What do you have?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn from Owen's gradebook, an apology for how he found out, and confirmation that nothing is on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a trip to the principal; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never got near it because no evidence was heard.
What moved her: Nothing, because you showed her no document, no time and no sample of Owen's work to check.
What cost ground: You asked her to step out and reassure you about being a bad teacher, which pulled the meeting away from Owen's essay and left her question about who decided the zero unanswered.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: When she asks who decided on the zero, answer in one sentence that it went in before you called her and that was wrong, then put one dated document in front of her.
